fusions.name: Lowing Chant
fusions.desc: Sends a pulse of sound into the first enemy it meets, dealing 7 damage. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Word Withheld
fusions.desc: Silences one enemy within 7 tiles for 3 seconds and deals 8 damage, taking its next action away and knocking it back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Droned Hymn
fusions.desc: Increases your cast speed by 30% for 15 seconds. It also pulls up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Practiced Cadence
fusions.desc: Every time you use an ability, a stack builds on you, up to 5. When you reach 5, they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per stack (30% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds. It also hardens your armour by 6% at all times.
